decision: Retain the actual-weight leaf as a runtime-unwired candidate. Add a fail-closed Qwen3.6-27B Q4 policy at row anchors 512:2048 and 1024:512 with no anchor at 2048/4096, select the pair producer for inclusive rows 512-2047, and require the complete category gate plus counterbalanced full-engine qualification before publication.
